    The reasoning behind each of the seven scores
    • Capability and differentiation: 3.0

Named customers

Organisations named in public sources as using this vendor’s tracked products, strongest evidence first.

No named customer could be confirmed from public sources. Vendors often cannot name bank customers, so this is not a finding about adoption.

How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Pricing

Pricing is usually not public. This states what is known, what is estimated, and what is not public.

Pricing
KnownNo prices are published. Three plans are sold on request: Core (DexGuard for Android or iXGuard for iOS, AppSweep testing, guided configuration and support), Control (adds ThreatCast threat monitoring and analytics) and Command (adds AppSweep Enterprise and server-side app attestation).; Basic support (email, response within three business days) is included; Gold support (email and phone, response within one business day) can be added to any package. Questions to ask the vendor (11)

  1. How many people does Guardsquare employ today, and how many of them work in engineering and in customer support?
    Headcount indicates the capacity to support and develop the product.
  2. What was Guardsquare's revenue in its last audited financial year, and can it share the annual accounts filed in Belgium?
    Revenue shows whether the vendor can fund the product from its own business.
  3. Which analyst reports from the last two years place Guardsquare, and in what position?
    Analyst placements are one public signal of market standing.
  4. How much primary capital has Guardsquare raised in total, and how much of the 2019 and 2025 transactions went into the company rather than to selling shareholders?
    Total capital raised is one indicator of how long the vendor can operate.
  5. Has Guardsquare made any workforce reductions in the last 24 months, including among staff who joined with the XTD, Runway and Bugfender acquisitions?
    Workforce reductions can signal financial stress or reduced support capacity.
  6. Can Guardsquare provide its latest audited annual accounts, including revenue, profit or loss, cash and borrowings?
    Financial statements show whether the vendor is profitable and how it is funded.
  7. Has Guardsquare or any group company been subject to any regulatory investigation, enforcement action or order in the last five years?
    Regulatory action against a supplier can affect its ability to serve a bank.
  8. Is Guardsquare party to any pending or recently resolved litigation, including intellectual property disputes over its protection technology?
    Material litigation can affect a supplier's finances and its right to sell the product.
  9. Has Guardsquare had any security incident affecting its platform, build tooling, licence distribution or customer data in the last five years, and how were customers told?
    A supplier of security software that is itself breached can expose its customers.
  10. Has Guardsquare lost any large financial-services customer in the last 24 months, and why?
    Loss of large customers can indicate product or service problems.
  11. Have there been any departures from or disputes within Guardsquare's executive team or board in the last 24 months, including since the Verdane investment?
    Leadership instability can affect product direction and support.

Timeline

  1. 2026-11-10 · acquisition Guardsquare
    Guardsquare announces acquisitions of Runway and Bugfender

    Guardsquare announced that it had acquired Runway, a mobile release management platform, and Bugfender, a remote logging and crash-reporting provider, adding release management and crash analytics to its mobile security products. Terms were not disclosed. Guardsquare (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-23, opens in new tab)

  2. 2026-02-05 · acquisition Guardsquare
    Guardsquare completes purchase of Verimatrix's XTD application protection assets

    Guardsquare and Verimatrix each announced completion of the sale of Verimatrix's Extended Threat Defense (XTD) assets, including patents and a team, to Guardsquare after regulatory approval. CSI Magazine reported at signing in December 2025 an initial price of US$8.5 million, to be adjusted at closing; the final price was not found. Guardsquare said XTD customers and partners would continue to be served without disruption.     Verdane announces an investment in Guardsquare

    The growth investor Verdane announced an investment in Guardsquare, following earlier investment by Battery Ventures, to fund organic growth and acquisitions. Completion was subject to regulatory approvals. The amount and the size of the stake were not disclosed; SecurityBrief reported that Battery Ventures continued its involvement.   4. 2025-05-06 · launch Guardsquare
    Guardsquare adds server-side mobile app attestation

    Guardsquare announced a mobile app attestation service that checks, on the server side, that an app calling a customer's APIs is genuine and running in a trusted environment, returning a signed short-lived token with a verdict. Policies can be changed without republishing the app. Guardsquare (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-23, opens in new tab)Guardsquare (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-23, opens in new tab)

  5. 2019-01-30 · acquisition Guardsquare
    Battery Ventures buys a majority stake in Guardsquare for US$29 million

    Guardsquare announced a US$29 million investment from Battery Ventures, its first institutional financing, with two Battery partners joining the board. Tech.eu and Unquote reported that Battery took a majority stake. The company said it then served more than 650 customers in over 70 countries.
